sources.role: machine configuration, input mapping and path resolution
ROM directory and machine ROM requirements
community Flatpak identity and sandbox status

paths.path: ~/.config/86box/86box.cfg (global config; a machine's 86box.cfg is next to its virtual-machine directory; -C/--config can select a config file)

The machine 86box.cfg INI sections [Input] and [Joystick *] store keyboard scan-code mappings plus joystick_*_axis_*, joystick_*_button_* and joystick_*_pov_* integer mappings; configure through Settings > Input devices.
paths.naming: INI keys include scancode_* and joystick_<n>_axis_<n>, joystick_<n>_button_<n>, joystick_<n>_pov_<n>; POV values are 'x, y'.
evidence: source:86Box/86Box src/config.c (load_input: scancode_config_map and joystick mapping keys)

paths.path: Inside the emulated machine's attached disk image(s), normally the machine directory's *.img/*.vhd/*.vhdx files; 86Box has no game-save sidecar format.
paths.naming: Guest OS/game-defined files inside the attached disk image; the image filename is user-selected.

paths.path: No verified save-state facility in the official 86Box desktop documentation/source; machine configuration snapshots are not emulation save states.
paths.naming: Not applicable: no documented 86Box state extension or slot naming.
evidence: docs:86box.readthedocs.io settings (settings and machine reset only)

paths.path: ROMs are searched in the configured ROM directory, normally ~/.local/share/86Box/roms (86Box ROM set); each emulated machine selects its own motherboard, video, SCSI and other ROM files.
paths.naming: Machine-specific ROM-set filenames are defined by 86Box's machine ROM tables; no single BIOS filename applies and the official ROM repository does not provide a universal canonical checksum for every optional ROM.

paths.path: No separate user key file; 86Box uses the ROM set and machine configuration described above.
paths.naming: No external key filename and no canonical key checksum published by 86Box.

linux.notes: Disk images contain guest saves. 86Box does not provide a cross-version portable state format; ROM identity is machine/ROM-set specific.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/net._86box._86Box/config/86box/86box.cfg and machine 86box.cfg files in the selected VM directory (Flatpak XDG config redirection).
Machine 86box.cfg [Input]/[Joystick *] INI keys: scancode_* and joystick_<n>_axis_<n>/button_<n>/pov_<n>; Flatpak receives the same device mapping from the desktop input stack.
paths.naming: Same 86Box INI mapping grammar; POV values are 'x, y'.

paths.path: Inside attached guest disk images, provided the Flatpak filesystem permission can reach the selected VM directory.
paths.naming: Guest-defined files inside *.img/*.vhd/*.vhdx images.

paths.path: No documented 86Box save-state facility.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: The community Flatpak's ROM add-on supplies the 86Box ROM set; user ROMs are selected through the same ROM directory/machine tables.
paths.naming: Machine-specific ROM names; no universal checksum declared by 86Box.

paths.path: No separate key file.
paths.naming: No external key filename/checksum.

paths.path: 86box.cfg in the 86Box install/VM directory; the global configuration is created in the documented Windows user-data location and a machine's 86box.cfg is beside that VM.
86box.cfg [Input]/[Joystick *] sections; scancode_* and joystick_<n>_axis_<n>/button_<n>/pov_<n> integer mappings are written by Settings > Input devices.
paths.naming: INI mapping keys as documented/source-defined; POV 'x, y'.

paths.path: Inside attached guest disk images in the VM directory; no 86Box sidecar save manager.
paths.naming: Guest-defined files in user-named *.img/*.vhd/*.vhdx images.

paths.path: No documented 86Box save states.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: The configured ROM directory (normally roms beside the install or the user data ROM directory) contains the official 86Box ROM set used by each machine.
paths.naming: Machine-specific ROM names from the source ROM tables; no universal checksum.

paths.path: No separate key file.
paths.naming: No external key filename/checksum.

paths.path: 86box.cfg in the selected VM directory, with the global config in 86Box's macOS application-support/user-data location; the exact machine config remains 86box.cfg.
Machine 86box.cfg [Input]/[Joystick *] sections use scancode_* and joystick axis/button/POV integer keys.
paths.naming: Same source-defined INI mapping grammar; POV 'x, y'.

paths.path: Inside attached guest disk images in the VM directory.
paths.naming: Guest-defined files inside user-named disk-image files; no emulator sidecar save format.

paths.path: No documented 86Box save states.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: The configured 86Box ROM directory contains machine-specific ROMs from the official ROM set.
paths.naming: Source machine-table filenames; no universal BIOS name/checksum.
